seo.metaTitle: Specialist talent & managed teams Services | Linkfields Innovations
seo.metaDescription: On-demand experts across verticals and outcome-based delivery pods. Scale specialist capability through staff augmentation or managed teams.
seo.keywords: specialist talent, managed teams, delivery pods, staff augmentation

sections.heading: Analysis and data-fuelled team building
sections.body:
By studying and analysis team outputs, we identify the discrepancies and shortcomings, and their specific areas of emergence. This helps us figure out what skill-set needs to be added to the team.

Specialist talent brings on-demand experts across verticals into your organisation. Managed teams provide outcome-based delivery pods, with the skills and coordination needed to take work forward.
sections.secondaryBody: A flexible outsourcing process can bring specialists into your existing teams. For a defined delivery outcome, Linkfields can build and run a managed team aligned to your requirements.
